name: RWJ_transform_joinery
description: This component transforms the joinery for roundwood elements with its surfaces and degrees of freedom, so it goes from its theoretical positions to its position aligned on the beam, prior to optimisation.

inputParameters.name: i_transformation
inputParameters.description: The transformation to be applied to the joint faces.

inputParameters.name: i_joinery
inputParameters.description: The joinery definition for the roundwood elements that we want to transform.

outputParameters.name: o_joinery
outputParameters.description: The transformed joinery for a single beam.
